name: Beef Rendang with Rice

components.name: Beef Rendang

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm cubes
Lemongrass stalks, white part only, sliced

steps: If using dried chillies, soak in hot water until soft. Blitz onion, garlic, ginger, galangal, lemongrass, chillies and some oil into a fine spice paste.
Brown beef in a heavy pan in two batches and transfer to a bowl.
Cook spice paste in the pot for several minutes until fragrant and darker in colour.
Return the beef; add coconut milk, tamarind, lime leaves, whole spices, sugar, coconut and salt.
Cover and keep at a low simmer for 75–90 minutes; uncover and reduce for another 30–60 minutes until the beef is soft and the sauce coats it rather than pooling.

components.name: Rice
steps: While finishing, cook the rice using the packet water ratio, then cool promptly after cooking.
Portion dry-style rendang and rice separately. Because of the long cook, this is an advanced/long-clock Sunday recipe.
